# Local fixture provenance

`fixture-math-v1` is original demonstration code shipped in this skills repository, not a real upstream math package. Its illustrative identifier is not an upstream release/tag. Source URL in the optional manifest points to the authoring repository only. There are no transitive dependencies, generated files, platform backends or patches.

Retained subset: the entire fixture (one header and one target definition). Update by editing these original fixture files together with their identifier and test. Real packages instead require an actual upstream commit/release identity, acquisition/update procedure and retained legal notices.

`../THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.txt` contains the complete applicable MIT text for this fixture; the original copy remains alongside it. No claim is made that this fixture exercises the licensing or build complexity of real Eigen/Ceres/SDL dependencies.
